mainland.zh: 他们拥有法国国籍。如果愿意，他们可以搬到法国本土。

mainland.en: It includes the European mainland and the island of Corsica in the Mediterranean.
mainland.zh: 它包括欧洲大陆以及地中海上的科西嘉岛。

mainland.en: It was connected to the mainland by long causeways.
mainland.zh: 它通过长长的堤道与大陆相连。

mainland.en: They were forced to flee, first to Cyprus, before having to escape from the island and return to mainland Europe.
mainland.zh: 他们被迫逃亡，先是逃到塞浦路斯，然后又不得不逃离该岛，返回欧洲大陆。

mainland.en: In fact, mainland Chile is over 3,500 kilometers away.
mainland.zh: 事实上，智利本土距离这里有3500多公里。

marvellous.en: It’s an amazing tale of bravery, marvellous inventions, strange creatures, and as we will discover, it is a story that has barely even got started.
marvellous.zh: 这是一个关于勇敢、奇妙发明和奇异生物的惊人故事，而且正如我们将发现的那样，这个故事才刚刚开始。

manual.en: These were manual industries that paid enough to support a middle-class lifestyle.
manual.zh: 这些体力劳动行业支付的薪水足以支撑中产阶级的生活方式。

manual.en: The north was industrial, factories, mines, dominated by manual labour.
manual.zh: 北方是工业化的，布满了工厂、矿井，以体力劳动为主。

manual.en: Most of my classmates were people working in more manual industries.
manual.zh: 我的大部分同学都是从事偏体力劳动行业的人。

maintenance.en: In the past, the government gave maintenance contracts to their political allies, people who paid them bribes.
maintenance.zh: 过去，政府把维护合同给了他们的政治盟友，也就是给他们行贿的人。

mastery.en: First is “mastery experiences”. Basically, successfully doing the task, repeatedly doing it successfully.
mastery.zh: 首先是“精通经验”。基本上就是成功完成任务，重复地成功完成它。

masterpiece.en: Turing’s masterpiece was the “Bombe “, an electromechanical machine designed to hunt for the daily Enigma key.
masterpiece.zh: Turing 的巅峰之作是“Bombe”，这是一种机电机器，旨在搜寻每日的 Enigma 密钥。

masterpiece.en: He painted masterpieces, studied the human body, designed new machines.
masterpiece.zh: 他绘制了杰作，研究了人体，设计了新型机器。

masterpiece.en: Masterpieces are the greatest works of an artist’s career.
masterpiece.zh: 杰作是一个艺术家职业生涯中最伟大的作品。

maiden.en: And she also actively wanted to keep using her Polish name, her maiden name we would say in English, which is why in this episode I have tried to say Marie Skłodowska-Curie, instead of just saying Marie Curie, because Marie Skłodowska-Curie wanted her name to be remembered as Skłodowska-Curie.
maiden.zh: 而且她还积极想要使用她的波兰名字，我们在英语中称之为娘家姓，这就是为什么在本期节目中我一直试图说 Marie Skłodowska-Curie，而不是只说 Marie Curie，因为 Marie Skłodowska-Curie 希望人们记住她的名字是 Skłodowska-Curie。
